title: Chaos to Creation
subtitle: Longevity & Regeneration Frontiers
tagline: Redefining life, aging, and human potential.
summary: A work of science and argument about why we age — and whether the body's own repair systems can be persuaded to hold the line.
description: Chaos to Creation takes the reader to the frontier of regenerative medicine, longevity science, and human performance. Drawing on three decades in orthopaedic surgery and research, Professor Gordon Slater examines the cellular and genetic mechanisms behind aging, and asks what stem cells, gene editing, and emerging biotechnology mean for the span of a human life. Positioned as a philosophical and scientific sequel to On the Origin of Species, it takes up Darwin's question from the other end: not how life began, but where it is going.
